Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing sales and use tax exemption cards for lowincome persons.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to sales and use tax exemptions for lowincomepersons; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) An eligible person is entitled to an annual sales and use taxexemption of four hundred fifty dollars per year. This exemption isavailable only through the use of a sales tax exemption card providedunder this section. A sales tax exemption card issued under thissection may be used only for exemption of taxes imposed under RCW82.08.020, and chapters 82.12 and 82.14 RCW. An unused portion of anannual exemption amount expires at the end of the year for which it isprovided, and may not be refunded or carried forward to subsequentyears. (2) The department of revenue shall establish a sales tax exemptioncard program for the purposes of this section, using debit cards,stored-value cards, or similar electronic media. Only cards,electronic media, and procedures approved by the department may be used p. 1 HB 2323for exemption of sales and use taxes under this section. Thedepartment shall prescribe forms and procedures for issuance andadministration of exemption cards. The department may contract withvendors for issuance and administration of the cards. The departmentmay charge a fee, or authorize a fee to be charged, from each eligibleperson for the cost of issuing a card, not to exceed ten dollars peryear per card. The department shall reconcile the fiscal impact ofexemptions under this section among state accounts and localgovernments in an appropriate manner. (3) As used in this section, "eligible person" means a resident ofthis state who has a combined disposable income, as defined in RCW84.36.383, that is less than one hundred fifty percent of the federalpoverty level as adjusted for household size and determined annually bythe federal department of health and human services.
